tasks.description: Explicit DEBUG-only local catalogue UI fixture factory over accepted REAL SDK/resources/model/repository/SQLite, persistent mock server ledger for app restart. No production view/launch-argument wiring yet.
constraints: Only allowed write_files ordinary contextual diff; both skeletons controller includes in app/unit Sources BEFORE evidence. No other files/project/config/tools/handoff/tasks/AGENTS/backend/contracts/deploy/live. Accepted native0a9f2ea and all150old tests preserved. This is TEST FIXTURE support ONLY for forthcoming actual UI; no views or app launch wiring, no production fallback/service rewrite. ALL new app fixture definitions inside #if DEBUG; release must have no factory/fake credentials/server. Future separate releasebuild gate verifies it once views wired. Do not use real keychain/accounts/URLs/privileged secrets; no external HTTP/images/provider calls.

Implement small explicit fixture factory async with closed enum scenarios (Free2,paid4,cap3,server409,server503,lostresponse,guestProviderCancel,guestProviderSuccess; shared primitives not duplicated full frameworks). It returns accepted CatalogueConnection using ONE actual SupabaseClient configured ONLY for https://<namespace>.invalid, injectable URLSession/URLProtocol that rejects every unknown URL, isolated AuthLocalStorage, actual LocalStore persistent namespace, existing API/engine/repo/model and NativeAuthService with fake IDENTITY provider but REAL SupabaseAuthExchange. No second fake model/sync engine or direct .saved state assignment. Native fake provider returns cancellation or fixture credentials; successful service MUST update actual SDK via mocked token HTTP, not synthesize NativeSignInResult.

Namespace must be caller-supplied validated UUID to confine files/metadata under dedicated app fixture directory and scoped UserDefaults; no arbitrary paths. Separate namespace isolates complete dataset/SDK storage/SQLite/metadata. Factory/context has cleanup/shutdown for unit tests and supports same namespace recreation across app restart without resetting queues/server receipts/auth state. Debug SDK AuthLocalStorage may persist ONLY generated non-secret fixture session data in dedicated fixture file (simulates SDK keychain persistence), never real credentials/appLocalStore/UserDefaults/logs. Production SDK default keychain untouched. Preserve existing correct metadata pointer+SQLite source API, no new app production persistence framework.

Mock server ledger durable before response: owner-scoped operation->original exact envelope/body/payload+canonical receipt+server-generated fixture UUID, inventory and scenario flags persisted atomically in debug namespace. Real command handler fixture validates caller token owner/anonymous, envelope and exact replay identity; replay returns SAME receipt/plantID, does not increment inventory/createcount. Lostresponse first commits ledger+inventory then throws URLError, recreating factory loads same ledger and full collectioncount3; production model pending resume must bypass new-create cap and use sameHTTPbody/op. Do NOT derive client plantUUID or deterministic response alone that hides duplicate commits. Fixture can choose literal valid fixture UUIDs server-side, existing typedreceipt validation applies. Unknown/wrong requests failclosed; never alter production API to accept mock envelope/status.

Canonical GETsync from ledger: until/has_more=false/last_cursor=null/next_since/profile/nullableentitlement/changes nesteddata shape, fixed sixdigit microseconds/nondecreasing timestamps, owner association only actual clientcontext. Inventory includes all live plants and created instance matching receipt UUID/data.id, plant_id/species/name/revision/care_revision/created_at for future actual card readback. No owner_id/items/slots/rooms/plan or caregeneration success fabricated. Paid fixture authoritative entitlement SQL predicate active/paid validfuture, Free nullable rights. POST commands normal/409/503 and lost/replay through actual production transport/engine/ACK. Server409 scenario independent of preflightcount (e.g initial2 then reject/race) to exercise authoritative rejection. Server receipt watermark never directly changes client sync checkpoint.

Mock actual SDK HTTP for anonymous signup/permanent initial signin/native token exchange/currentuser/logout/refresh only needed routes and catalogue RPC search_catalogue_species returning one published-shaped species (EN/PL/scientificname/description optional, hero null so zero media downloads). Use real SDK auth methods to seed correct isAnonymous; preserve scoped SDK session across fixture recreation, no spurious signup after restart. Mockledger authkind/owner metadata allowed, no extraanalysis/quota/installations API invention. ConnectionModel factory from accepted native code determines permissions and continuation, no default permanent flags in app. Release or absent fixture request never calls this factory (wiring separate).

Add>=6 actual tests in new already-target CatalogueUIFixtureTests (#ifDEBUG as needed) + all150old =>>=156/no skips. Drive real connection/model/nativeService/API/engine/SQLite against fixture (not merely test fixture code): Free2 save->serverID+canonical readback; paid4; cap3 zeroPOST; precheck2/server409 and503 preserveinput/pending; committedlostresponse+factory recreation currentcount3+restore+explicitretry samebody/op/one serverreceipt+durableACK; actual SDK guestcancel/nativeSuccess on SAMEclient with checkpointbeforeprovider and no otherowner transfer; namespaces isolated/fakeauth metadata persists and unknownURL blocked. Focus bounded tests reuse existing model, no renderedUI claim; screenshots/UI launch mode and Releasebuild later. Trusted build/unit/Simulator, independent Reviewer/QA required; fixtures are not live Auth/SQL/AI/StoreKit/fullparents.
